dedupe_keys.name: openearth dutch sea level monitoring workflow

description: OpenEarth's sealevel repository contains tools, notebooks and a public application for monitoring sea-level rise in the Netherlands. Its README separates analysis notebooks, scripts for common data sources and the website. Users provide tide-gauge or other sea-level records and run the documented processing steps; outputs are plots and indicators of change for Dutch coastal monitoring. Geographic coverage is the Netherlands where the source records apply. GitHub metadata states GPL-3.0 licensing for the code. A limitation is that an observed historical trend is not a complete projection of future local flood levels; storm surge, subsidence and uncertainty need separate treatment. Source observation terms and calibration should be checked before reuse. The workflow can supply monitoring context for coastal flood-defence simulations. The related catalogue ERA5 record is atmospheric reanalysis, not Dutch sea-level observations. No tide-gauge records, notebooks or app build were downloaded.
name: OpenEarth Dutch sea-level monitoring workflow
